name: md-tech-pdf
description: Export technical Markdown documents to PDF with Mermaid and PlantUML support.

md-tech-pdf.plantuml.javaPath.description: Path to the Java executable used by PlantUML.

md-tech-pdf.plantuml.jarPath.description: Path to the local PlantUML JAR file.

md-tech-pdf.export.outputDirectory.description: Default output directory for Export to PDF. Leave empty to use the Markdown file directory.

md-tech-pdf.export.afterExport.description: Action to perform automatically after a successful PDF export.

md-tech-pdf.preview.refresh.description: Controls when an open md-tech-pdf preview is refreshed.

md-tech-pdf.preview.debounceDelay.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before refreshing the preview when preview.refresh is set to onType (minimum: 100ms, default: 500ms).

md-tech-pdf.preview.cache.persistent.description: Enable persistent disk caching for rendered Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams across VS Code sessions.

md-tech-pdf.preview.scrollSync.enabled.description: Initial scroll synchronization state between editor and preview.

md-tech-pdf.preview.scrollSync.behavior.description: Scroll animation behavior when synchronizing scroll position with editor.

md-tech-pdf.preview.scrollSync.delay.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for scroll synchronization between editor and preview.

md-tech-pdf.preview.zoom.description: Initial zoom magnification level for the preview display.

md-tech-pdf.preview.defaultViewMode.description: Initial view mode for document preview: 'paged' (page-by-page sheet view) or 'continuous' (seamless scrolling web view).

md-tech-pdf.styles.description: List of custom CSS file paths (relative to workspace or document) to apply to preview and PDF export.

md-tech-pdf.default.pdf.format.description: Default PDF paper format when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.pdf.landscape.description: Default PDF page orientation (true for landscape, false for portrait) when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.pdf.margin.top.description: Default PDF page top margin when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.pdf.margin.bottom.description: Default PDF page bottom margin when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.pdf.margin.left.description: Default PDF page left margin when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.pdf.margin.right.description: Default PDF page right margin when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.diagram.width.description: Default diagram container width (e.g. '140mm', '80%') when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.diagram.height.description: Default diagram container height (e.g. '80mm', '400px') when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.diagram.fit.description: Default diagram fit behavior ('contain' or 'fill') when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.diagram.align.description: Default diagram alignment ('center', 'left', or 'right') when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.style.font.family.description: Default font family for body text when unspecified in Front Matter.

md-tech-pdf.default.style.font.codeFamil.description: Default font family for code blocks and monospace text when unspecified in Front Matter.

name.description: Google Font family name (e.g. 'LINE Seed JP', 'Noto Sans JP').

weights.description: List of font weights to load (e.g. [400, 700]).

md-tech-pdf.default.style.font.google.fa.description: Default Google Fonts to load when unspecified in Front Matter.

scripts.pretest:extension: npm run build && npm run compile:tests
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run compile:tests
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:extension
